t: Call Between Alexey Navalny and FSB Officer Konstantin Kudryavtsev [English Subtitles]

q.x: If you haven't seen the full investigation released last week I'd strongly recommend you check it out, top notch investigative journalism.

desc:
Full call between Navalny and one of the FSB officers in the team to trail and eventually poison him, Konstantin Kudryavtsev.

Before the publication of our recent joint investigation into the FSB officers involved in the operation to poison him in Tomsk, Navalny decided to call two members of the poison squad, Mikhail Shvets and Konstantin Kudryavtsev, by impersonating a senior security official.

recs.stt: Russian opposition leader Navalny dupes spy into revealing how he was poisoned
recs.x:
If you haven't seen the full investigation released last week I'd strongly recommend you check it out, top notch investigative journalism. The video has English subtitles: [link] 

Also here's the full phone call with the FSB agent, with english transcript: [link]

It's the most impressive investigative work I have ever read. One can only imagine the capabilities of nation state actors if an NGO is capable of this.

Even more incredible is that Alexei Navalny personally called an FSB officer and was able to extract a confession: [link]
